name: Create Rhythm Notation Lesson Flipchart
description:
A 3rd grade music teacher needs a lesson flipchart on rhythm basics. Create a 4-page ActivInspire flipchart saved as '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/rhythm_basics.flipchart' with the following content:

Page 1 - Title Page: Add the title 'Rhythm Basics' and a subtitle about note values.

Page 2 - Note Value Chart: Create a visual reference for these four notes: Whole Note (4 beats), Half Note (2 beats), Quarter Note (1 beat), Eighth Note (1/2 beat). Draw a circle or ellipse shape for each note head and label them with their names and beat values.

Page 3 - Counting Exercise: Add a title 'Count the Beats' and numbers 1, 2, 3, 4 to represent a measure of 4/4 time.

Page 4 - Activity: Add a title 'Clap the Rhythm' and a simple clapping pattern or instruction.

Note: You must start a new flipchart and use the Shape tool for the note heads on Page 2.
